name: FIRST Robotics Competition
blurb: Our main team, Team 1102. Students work in five subteams to take a robot from sketch to competition floor, and run the team like a small company while they do it.
when: Year-round, with short breaks. Off-season meetings are Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

name: FIRST LEGO League
blurb: A team for students who are not ready for FRC yet. They build and program LEGO robots and learn how a team solves problems together.

name: Off-season events
blurb: Between seasons we compete at off-season events, train new members on real equipment, and open our doors to families at events like Robo-Day.
when: See the events page for dates.
